facts.fact: TechAfrica News reports Djibouti's National Assembly passed its first Digital Code in plenary, eight books and nearly 800 articles including Book VI on Cybersecurity and Cybercrime, with no mention of promulgation or entry into force; no event date given, so the published date of 2025-07-02 is used.
facts.system: Digital Code (Code du numérique), Book VI Cybersecurity and Cybercrime

systems.owner: Ministry of Digital Economy and Innovation (MDENI)
